text:
Residents' Routines:
Felix (40s): Weekdays, home in the morning; out at work 13:40–23:00. Weekends, off work; errands midday, home otherwise. Hobbies: movies, houseplants.
Aisha (50s): Works from home. Weekdays, at desk 09:00–17:30; sometimes out for lunch. Weekends, sleeps in; errands midday, home otherwise. Hobbies: friends, meditation, movies.
Ines (30s): Works from home. Weekdays, at desk 09:00–17:30; sometimes out for lunch. Weekends, sleeps in; errands midday, home otherwise. Hobbies: baking, reading, running.

Object Locations & Movement:
Balcony: Watering can (floor), gardening gloves (table).
Bathroom: Hair dryer, laundry basket, Aisha’s razor/skincare, Ines’ skincare (shelf). Aisha/Felix meds (cabinet). Soap, toothbrushes, Felix’s razor (sink). Towels for all (rack).
Bedroom 1 (Felix): Pen, plant pot 3 (desk). Book, glasses, tablet (nightstand).
Bedroom 2 (Aisha): Meditation cushion (floor). Headphones, laptop, mug, pen (desk). Book (nightstand).
Bedroom 3 (Ines): Headphones, laptop, mug, pen (desk). Book (nightstand).
Entry: Doormat, Aisha/Felix umbrellas (floor). Aisha/Ines jackets, Aisha/Ines scarves (hook). Aisha/Ines keys, Ines sunglasses, Aisha/Ines wallets (table). Ines running shoes, Aisha/Ines shoes (rack).
Kitchen: Cutting board, kettle, knife block, plant pot 2 (counter). Pan, pot, snack bowl (cupboard). Aisha plate (dish rack). Knife, spatula (drawer). Fruit bowl, Felix plate (table). Baking tray, mixing bowl, recipe book, shopping bag (pantry). Bowls/glasses/mugs/plates for all (sink).
Living: Board game, speaker, vase (bookshelf). Candle, coasters, magazines for all, tissue box (coffee table). Blanket (couch). Lamp, plant pot 1 (side table). Remote (TV stand).
Storage: Ironing board, vacuum (floor). Toolbox (shelf).

Notes:
- Felix is absent during the 22:00 patrol on weekdays.
- Aisha and Ines are typically home during evening patrols on weekdays.
- Pockets and bags are not inspected.

Dynamic Objects & Patterns:
- Felix’s items (backpack, jacket, keys, phone, scarf, shoes, sunglasses, wallet, water bottle): Usually at entry spots in the morning. Taken OUT_OF_HOUSE by Felix around 16:00 for work.
- Aisha’s phone: Usually on nightstand_b2. Taken OUT_OF_HOUSE by Aisha around 08:00 (likely lunch/errand).
- Ines’ phone: Usually on nightstand_b3. Taken OUT_OF_HOUSE by Ines around 08:00 (likely lunch/errand).
- Ines’ desk items (headphones, mug, water bottle): Move from desk_b3 to nightstand_b3 or kitchen in the morning, return to desk_b3 by 09:24 for work.
- Aisha’s desk items (laptop, mug, pen): Move to nightstand_b2 or kitchen in the morning, return to desk_b2 by 16:00.
- Shared kitchen items (bowls, glasses, mugs, plates): Often moved from sink/dish rack to cupboard_k1 overnight, then redistributed to sinks/tables during the day.
- Aisha’s jacket/scarf: Move from entry_hook_e1 to wardrobe_b2 overnight, return to entry_hook_e1 by 16:00.
- Felix’s razor: Moves from medicine_cabinet_ba1 to sink_ba_ba1
